selection_protocol.split: F3 configuration selection on Jan-Aug inner training and September inner validation; configurations transferred to fixed-budget refits.
selection_protocol.provenance_status: Historical HPO input IDs, runner and study database are absent. The reported 79,997 inner-training rows cannot be verified against the packaged S90k, which contains 80,000 Jan-Aug trips completed before September 1.

LightGBM.note: Exact match to Paper v9 Sec IV-D (column sampling 0.85, no row bagging as subsample_freq=0) and main notebook. Note: DAP391m_Nhom27_Submission/configs/lightgbm_best.yaml had a static doc typo listing colsample_bytree=1.0, whereas actual trained checkpoints in both packages use colsample_bytree=0.85.

OSRM.rule: Use osrm_min when route_status == 'ok' and osrm_min > 0; otherwise use training median duration by OD pair, then weekly slot, then global. Predictions are minutes and are multiplied by 60 for duration-error metrics.

TEMP.rule: Fit mean Haversine speed (km/h) by weekly slot using training rows with haversine_km > 0 and dur_min > 0. Replace missing slot speeds with the global valid-speed mean. Average dur_min * training slot speed by OD pair. Predict this OD mean divided by query slot speed (clipped below at 1e-8). For nonfinite predictions, use training median duration by OD pair, then weekly slot, then global. Predictions are minutes.
